shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving on coarse grey-brown stone
curving arc-shaped elements (animal limbs in A, curved bands/arms in B)
a circular or oval depression/disc motif
vertically stacked motifs on a broad flat stone face
justification: Both are shallow reliefs pecked into a large flat face of coarse stone, with motifs stacked one above another and including curved limb-like arcs and a round disc or hollow. But A depicts recognisable quadrupeds in profile on an embedded architectural block seen in situ, while B is a freestanding anthropomorphic statue whose back carries abstract rings and bands, so the subject matter, format and viewing context scarcely correspond.
